items.l1_text: If two sets of scores have the same mean, with one set of scores concentrated near the mean and the other widely varying from high to low, then it is hard to tell which is better from the mean alone.

prev.l2: 平均数只能告诉我们一组数据的中心位置，却无法揭示它们彼此之间的差异。
prev.l1: The mean can only tell us the central position of a set of data, but cannot reveal the differences among them.

next.l2: 方差正是为弥补这一缺憾而生：它把每个数据与均值的离差平方后求平均，从而将整体的离散程度凝练为一个数值。
next.l1: Variance is born precisely to make up for this shortcoming: it squares each data point's deviation from the mean and then averages them, thereby condensing the overall degree of dispersion into a single number.

items.l2_text: 进了景区,所谓游览更像被人流推着前行:观景台上摩肩接踵,拍一张照要排半天队,人山人海,举步维艰。
items.l1_text: Once inside the scenic area, so-called sightseeing is more like being pushed forward by the crowd: the viewing platform is shoulder to shoulder, taking a single photo means queuing for half a day, a sea of people, every step difficult.

prev.l2: 天还没亮,山门外的队伍已蜿蜒数里,游客攥着手机反复刷新页面,唯恐门票预约名额在几分钟内被抢空。
prev.l1: Before dawn, the queue outside the mountain gate has already wound for several li, and tourists clutch their phones and refresh the page repeatedly, fearing that the ticket reservation slots will be snatched up within a few minutes.

next.l2: 于是不少人开始反思自己的出行方式。

items.l1_text: Some split the holiday into two parts and go at off-peak times; some give up internet-famous attractions and turn to small towns and villages that are not very famous but have quiet, beautiful scenery.

next.l1: Travel guides have been updated accordingly, no longer simply listing "must-visit check-in spots", but reminding readers to pay attention to crowd-limiting announcements and weather changes.

items.l2_text: 一条“包装精美，但物流太慢”的评论，人一眼就能读出褒贬，机器却难以直接处理。
items.l1_text: For a comment like "beautifully packaged, but delivery is too slow", a person can read the praise and criticism at a glance, but a machine finds it hard to process directly.

prev.l2: 相比之下，非结构化数据没有统一格式，顾客留下的评论文本、上传的商品图片都属于此类。
prev.l1: By comparison, unstructured data has no uniform format; the comment text customers leave and the product pictures they upload both belong to this category.

next.l2: 为了解决这一难题，研究人员往往先请专人对大量评论进行标注，例如把句子归为“好评”或“差评”，再让算法从中学习规律。
next.l1: To solve this problem, researchers often first ask dedicated people to annotate large numbers of comments, for example classifying sentences as "positive reviews" or "negative reviews", and then let algorithms learn patterns from them.

prev.l1: In the north, a New Year's Eve dinner without dumplings is not considered complete; and for many people, making dumplings is itself the most concrete form of family reunion: several pairs of hands busy at the same chopping board, the conversation stretching from the gains and losses of the old year to the plans for the new one.
